name: Kinga Kollár - Proposition de décision du Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Amending Protocol to the Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of San Marino on the automatic exchange of financial account information to improve international tax compliance
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign an updated tax agreement with San Marino. The update makes the two sides share more kinds of financial account information automatically, including new products like electronic money and central bank digital currencies. It also updates the privacy rules to match the European Union's data protection law. The aim is to help both sides fight tax evasion and money laundering. The Parliament gives its opinion; the Council then decides whether to conclude the agreement.

- The update widens automatic sharing of financial account data and aligns privacy rules with European Union law.
- It affects tax authorities and account holders in European Union countries and San Marino.
- The Council can now adopt the decision to conclude the agreement; the new rules apply from 1 January 2026.
